flash: Make sure only one BlueField-2 DPU Controller is connected to your host.
Make sure your BlueField-2 DPU Controller is installed according to the instructions in the hardware user guide.
Connect the USB cable provided with your DPU package to the USB interface of the DPU controller.
Make sure the out-of-band interface (mgmt) is connected to the internet.
(Optional) In case you acquired the accessories kit, please connect the UART cable to the NC-SI UART interface of the DPU.
